[color=#6d9eeb][size=6][u][b][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776454-869883807.png[/img][/b][/u][/size][/color][font=Arial]
[size=2]Stardew Valley is constantly changing from season to season and year to year... So why shouldn't you?!?  [/size]
[size=2]This mod replaces the static inventory tabs with animated ones to match the changing nature of the valley![/size]

[u][color=#f1c232][size=3][b]Most inventory tabs (including skills and collections) are replaced with an animated versions![/b][/size][/color][/u]
[size=2]Inventory Tab:  Changed to a chest opening and closing[/size]
[size=2]Skills Tab:  Cannot be animated as far as our testing has shown (it is used in too many other places)[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Farming:  Changed it from a nondescript root vegetable to a radish that is planted and grows[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Mining:  Modified the existing pickaxe to shine and sparkle[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Foraging:  Changed it from a small tree (Nothing to do with foraging) to a berry bush that rotates through the seasons[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Fishing:  Changed it from a bobber and fish to a hook and fish that catches and releases (that one is too small anyways)[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Combat:  Modified the existing sword to shine and sparkle[/size]
[size=2]Social Tab:  Changed the color of the heart and made it beat[/size]
[size=2]Map Tab:  Modified the existing map to furl and unfurl[/size]
[size=2]Crafting Tab:  Modified the existing hammer to hit the side of the tab[/size]
[size=2]Collections Tab:  Modified the existing golden bottle to empty and then fill before a small fairy enters and changes the color[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Items Shipped Subtab:  Changed the radish to a shipping box which is more on track to what this tab represents[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Fish:  Modified the existing fish to flop its tail[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Artifacts:  Modified the existing artifact to crumble into dust and reform[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Minerals:  Modified the existing green crystals to sparkle[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Cooking:  Modified the existing plate to slide up, be filled with salmon and asparagus, and slide back down before being devoured, YUMM![/size]
[size=2] ﻿Achievements:  Modified the existing star to shine and twinkle[/size]
[size=2] ﻿Letters:  Modified the existing envelope to open and slide out a letter[/size]
[size=2] ﻿The last one:  I don't want to spoil it but this one is animated too[/size]
[size=2]Options:  Changes it from the game controller to a book opening and closing, I tried a gear but it didn't look right[/size]
[size=2]Exit Game:  I left this un-animated and just changed the shade of red and the shadow because having it animated felt like it was taunting you to quit[/size]

[size=2]Using [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=2], a portion of "Content\LooseSprites\Cursors.xnb" is replaced with our ([/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/users/75703183]PaulDunstan[/url][size=2] and [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/6056146]Myself[/url][size=2]) edited version.[/size]
[/font][size=2][font=Arial]
[color=#ffd966]UPDATE 1/29/2022:[/color] Added (configurable) [color=#ff0000]Collection Tabs Deluxe Tooltips[/color]. Check pictures for more information.
[color=#ffd966]UPDATE 2/13/2022:[/color] Added two additional versions compatible with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1244/]Vintage Interface V1[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface V2[/url]﻿!
[/font][/size]



[u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645779750-777928429.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/u][u]
[/u][font=Arial][size=2]Admittedly I have not yet tried it with a mod loader because I typically do things manually but it should work fine.

[color=#f1c232][b]1)[/b] [/color]Install and/or update Stardew Valley.

[color=#f1c232][b]2)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]3)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].﻿

[color=#f1c232][b]4)[/b] [/color]Download and/or update [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url].

[color=#f1c232][b]5)[/b] [/color]Download this mod, then extract it.[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]6)[/color][/b][size=2] Move the extracted folder (which contains the assets folder as well as, content.json, & manifest.json) into your "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder so that the final file structure looks like this: "SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Animated Inventory Tabs\assets"[/size]

[b][color=#f1c232]7)[/color][/b][size=2][color=#f1c232] [/color]That's it you're done, enjoy! (Ask in comments or PM me if you have any issues...)[/size][font=Arial][size=2]
[/size][/font][/font][font=Arial]



[/font][u][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=6][img]http://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/11112/11112-1645776467-497634449.png[/img][/size][/color][/b][/u]
[font=Arial][size=2][size=2]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5.4, 1.5.5 and 1.5.6 [/size]CONFIRMED[size=2]. Probably works with earlier versions as well but I haven't tested it with anything less than 1.5.4.[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Windows and macOS (I have not tested it on Linux but I don't see why it wouldn't work there too)[/size]

[size=2]Compatible with Single-player and Multiplayer.[/size]

[u][color=#f1c232][size=5][b]Mod Compatibility:[/b][/size][/color][/u]
-No mod [b]conflicts[/b] that I know of yet.
[/size][/font][font=Arial][size=2][b]
-Issues [/b]may arise if you have any other mods installed that LOAD the same files. [/size][/font]
